name: SANCY
recent: Sancy Berhad 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日召开第 4 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过，包括董事薪酬、董事重选、续聘核数师及发行股份授权。公司另于 2026 年 11 月 24 日发布一项「其他」公告，但资料未提供具体内容。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 2026 年 9 月 23 日第 4 届常年股东大会所有决议均获通过，包括批准董事薪酬上限 RM20,000、重选 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Shahril Bin Shamsuddin 为董事、续聘 PCCO PLT 为核数师，以及授出发行股份的一般授权。

recent_en: Sancy Berhad held its 4th AGM on 23 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by shareholders, covering directors' fees, re-election of a director, re-appointment of auditors and authority to issue shares. The company also issued an 'OTHERS' announcement on 24 November 2026, but details were not provided. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: All resolutions at the 4th AGM on 23 September 2026 were passed, including approval of directors' fees capped at RM20,000, re-election of Tan Sri Dato' Seri Shahril Bin Shamsuddin as director, re-appointment of PCCO PLT as auditors, and a general mandate to issue shares.
